# Retained Ultra2 public source recipes

`recipes.json` is a source-only hypothesis manifest generated by
`scripts/plan_retained_ultra2_public.py` from pinned predecessor and retained
Ultra2 source recipes. See `docs/reference-ultra2-retained-public-plan.md` for
bounds, exact predecessor transitions and qualification evidence. No native
observation or successful public admission is encoded as an assumption here.

Reference algorithm/preset lineage: facebook/zstd v1.5.7, revision
`f8745da6ff1ad1e7bab384bd1f9d742439278e99`, dual BSD-3-Clause/GPL-2.0 licensing.
Independent deterministic source recipes preserve their attribution through the
pinned helper and predecessor manifests.
